scope_definition: Minimal causal architecture required to express and falsify Competitive Local Reproduction Theory in the native Rust engine; excludes empirical validation, parameter identification, historical transport, and optional realism.

police_professionalism.meaning: Local professional standard: training, procedural discipline, investigative competence, and institutional behavior independent of staffing.

formation_experience.meaning: Accumulated formation-level field experience/veterancy independent of structural quality.

core_invariants: Mobility is relocation, not endogenous reproduction.
External support may sustain an endogenously subcritical organization and is tracked separately from endogenous reproduction.
Police quantity and police professionalism are distinct causal dimensions.
Formation quality and formation experience are distinct causal dimensions.
Replacing personnel can restore headcount while reducing unit veterancy.
Intelligence penetration can damage the reproductive underground without instantaneously deleting already-fielded coercive capacity.
State regeneration is hierarchical and fiscal-institutional rather than a symmetric copy of insurgent reproduction.
The state-regeneration extension defaults off; theory-v2 activation is explicit.

engineering_certificate.enabled_checkpoint_continuation: exact decision_hash and state_hash equality tested

checkpoint_compatibility_policy.reason: Do not silently reinterpret archived continuation state after adding theory-relevant stocks. Legacy checkpoints remain reproducible under their matching archived git revision; an explicit migration tool can be added only if scientifically required.

remaining_work_is_not_core_architecture: historical predictive competition and cross-case transport
promotion_rule: CORE_ARCHITECTURE_IMPLEMENTED does not license a general-theory claim. Promotion requires the surviving synthetic and historical falsification gates defined by the research program.
